title: console: /forms/NAME for a missing form renders a raw English "Form metadata not found" in a non-English session
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase, sign in as admin, and set the user's language to zh-CN (avatar menu, or `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user/ID {"locale":"zh-CN"}`).
2. Open `/_console/forms/no_such_form`.
3. Expected: localized not-found copy, like the other console not-found states.
4. Actual: the page body renders the untranslated literal "Form metadata not found: view/no_such_form".

## Mechanism
`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` ~L1728 throws a hard-coded English string, and the `error` text is rendered verbatim (~L2687–2691). It never passes through the i18n layer.
